200.description: Quote from the database read model

Snapshot matches, dimensions, date, total, successCount, insufficientCount, missingCount and coverage; coverage reports the available state-date range (first_date/last_date), covered/total pool size, whether the requested date has any state rows (trade_date_exists), and skipped stocks with reason: no_quote, insufficient_history (a dimension missing or marked insufficient) or not_computed. Results contain full four-dimensional state vectors.

get.summary: AND screening of persisted daily signal states
get.description: Replaces the removed signals OR parameter. No live signal detection or 500-code cap. Reads one shared date; omitted date uses the newest snapshot trade date. Reports insufficientCount (stock-days with incomplete/insufficient vectors) and missingCount (codes without that date) for compatibility, plus coverage: first_date/last_date of available state dates, covered/total, trade_date_exists (whether the requested date has any state rows at all), and skipped[{code,name,reason}] where reason is no_quote (no trade bar that day: suspended, not yet listed, delisted), insufficient_history (state rows present but the four dimensions are incomplete, or marked insufficient) or not_computed (trade bar exists but that day's state has not been generated). Results carry date, all four states, and local historical close/PrevClose; dimensions carries canonical labels, direction, direction_label, colors and descriptions.
